name: Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme
benefit:
> ***Financial Assistance***

₹5,000/- per pilgrim as financial assistance towards travel expenses for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya.
> ***Travel Arrangements***

- Travel arrangements through the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited.
- Railway journey assistance and booking support.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state for twelve years or more from the current age. - The applicant must belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. - The applicant must be eligible for only one pilgrimage assistance per person per year to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. - The applicant must be above 12 years of age. - The applicant can include up to 8 family members in the group application. - The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board before undertaking the journey. ***Priority/Preference*** Priority will be given to the first 1,500 registered applicants from the scheduled tribe and tribal communities.
